Step-by-Step Guide to Tambaram Property Tax Payment Online

Follow these precise steps for hassle-free tambaram municipality property tax payment online. The official portal, tnurbanepay.tn.gov.in, handles TCMC seamlessly.

Step 1: Access the Portal

Launch your browser and visit https://tnurbanepay.tn.gov.in. Select "Tambaram City Municipal Corporation" from the dropdown under Quick Payment. No login needed for one-time pays, but register for history tracking—enter name, mobile, email, and assessment details.

Step 2: Choose Property Tax Option

Click "Property Tax" under Quick Payment. Input your Assessment Number and captcha. Hit "Submit" to fetch dues—current demand, arrears, incentives appear instantly. Cross-check details like property address and owner name for accuracy.

Step 3: Review Dues and Proceed

View breakdown: basic tax, water charges, lighting cess. For tambaram property tax online payment, confirm total (e.g., ₹10,000 principal minus 5% rebate). Opt for full or partial payment. Errors? Use "View Payment History" or contact helpline 044-28554321.

Step 4: Select Payment Mode

Choose from UPI (PhonePe, Google Pay), net banking (all major banks), debit/credit cards (Visa/Mastercard), or wallets. For tambaram corporation property tax online payment, UPI shines for zero fees and instant confirmation. Enter details securely—portal uses SSL encryption.

Step 5: Complete Transaction and Download Receipt

Authorize payment; receive SMS/email with transaction ID. Download e-receipt with QR code for records—valid for banks or disputes. Save PDF for mutations or loans. Done in under 5 minutes!

Pro tip: Pay half-yearly (April-September, October-March) to manage cash flow, especially for larger tambaram house tax online payment in apartments.
